USE CASES

What you can do

Turn material into documents

Ask the model to read files in your workspace, organize their contents or write a new document.

Edit code and review results

Describe the changes in conversation, then inspect the edited files and tool results in the workspace.

Set up tools for your tasks

Add tools for recurring work, with separate instructions and files for each conversation.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Features

01

Connect AI models

Choose a supported provider or configure an API endpoint and model. Available models depend on your account and environment.

02

A workspace for each conversation

Give each conversation its own folder and instructions for reading and editing files. View the conversation alongside the files it produces.

03

Review tool execution

Follow tool progress and results during a conversation. Read documents, tables and code blocks, then continue with another request.

04

Add task-specific tools

Write tools and add them to the workspace. This is intended for developers who want to adapt tool behavior to recurring tasks.

05

Branch a conversation

Copy a completed conversation and its files to explore another direction. Running or queued tasks are not copied to the branch.

06

Replace running code

We are researching a workflow for modifying execution code and switching to a new version, with separate handling for the current response and subsequent tasks.

WORKFLOW

How to use it

The basic steps to get started.

  1. 01

    Prepare the environment

    Install and run Moru in a development environment. The project currently requires Node.js 26 or later.

  2. 02

    Connect a model

    Complete the provider’s connection flow or configure the API and model you want to use.

  3. 03

    Describe the task

    Start a conversation, explain the result you want, and use files in the workspace. Add tools if needed.

  4. 04

    Review and revise

    Inspect changed files and execution results. Request revisions in the same conversation or branch it to try another direction.

BEFORE YOU START

Requirements & limitations

Product type
Runs on your computer and is used through a browser
Intended users
People comfortable setting up a development environment and an AI model connection
Runtime
Currently requires Node.js 26 or later. External API access may be needed for the selected model.
Distribution
Research and development. No public hosted demo or general-user installer is provided.

CURRENT STATUS

Research & development

A research project for developers and advanced users. The workspace runs locally, but the selected model may require external APIs and a network connection.

Frequently asked questions

Can I use it without the internet?+

Running locally means the workspace runs on your computer. Depending on the model connection, external services and internet access may be required. Fully offline inference is not guaranteed.

Is it a finished product for general users?+

It is still in research and development. Installation and model configuration are required, and there is no general-user installer yet.
